requirements.title: Seller lists item
requirements.text: The system shall allow a seller to list an item with a starting price, an end time, an item currency chosen from CHF, EUR or USD, and an optional reserve price.
acceptanceCriteria: A seller can submit an item with a starting price, an end time and a currency (CHF, EUR or USD) and it then appears as an open auction.
A listing without a starting price, end time or currency is rejected with an error message.
A listing with a currency other than CHF, EUR or USD is rejected.
A listing submitted without a reserve price is accepted and appears as an open auction.
A listing submitted with a reserve price is accepted subject to the rules in REQ-012.

requirements.title: Place bid
requirements.text: The system shall accept a bid on an open auction item only if the bidder is not the item's seller and the bid meets the minimum bid rule, with bids entered and stored in the item currency.
acceptanceCriteria: A bid on an item whose end time has not passed, from a user other than the seller, is stored in the item currency if it is valid.
A bid on an item whose end time has passed is rejected.
The first bid is accepted only if it is at least the starting price.
Any later bid is accepted only if it is at least 1 unit of the item currency higher than the current highest bid, otherwise it is rejected.
A bid by the item's seller on their own item is rejected.

requirements.title: Live bid updates
requirements.text: The system shall push each new bid to all clients currently watching that item without the client reloading the page.
acceptanceCriteria: When a bid is accepted, every client watching the item shows the new bid without a page reload.
A client watching a different item does not receive that bid.
When a bid or close event arrives, the list of open items refreshes without a page reload.
If loading the live update configuration fails, the page retries and live updates start once it succeeds.

requirements.title: Auction close and winner
requirements.text: The system shall close an auction when its (possibly extended) end time is reached, declare the highest bidder the winner if the item has no reserve price or the highest bid meets the reserve, and otherwise mark the item as unsold with no winner, including when it has no bids.
acceptanceCriteria: At the end time the item no longer accepts bids.
For an item without a reserve price, the bidder with the highest bid at the end time is recorded as the winner and the winning user sees on the item page that they won.
For an item with a reserve price, a highest bid at or above the reserve makes that bidder the winner.
For an item with a reserve price, a highest bid below the reserve makes the item unsold, with no winner recorded or announced.
Watchers of the item see the closed state and the winner, or the unsold state when there is no winner.
An auction that ends with no bids is shown as unsold and has no winner.

requirements.title: Prices in bidder currency
requirements.text: The system shall display prices to a bidder in the bidder's chosen display currency (CHF, EUR or USD) in addition to the item currency, converted using exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.app), while bids and stored prices stay in the item currency.
acceptanceCriteria: A bidder who selects CHF, EUR or USD sees item prices and bids converted with a rate obtained from Frankfurter.
Only CHF, EUR and USD are offered as display currencies.
Converted prices are shown with the currency code.
Conversion is for display only: stored bids and bid validation use the item currency.

requirements.title: Separate services
requirements.text: The system shall be built as separately deployable services, including at least an API server and a separate live update server.
acceptanceCriteria: The API server and the live update server run as separate processes or deployments.
Either service can be started, stopped and deployed without redeploying the other.

requirements.title: Horizontal scalability
requirements.text: The system shall allow the API server and the live update server to be scaled independently by running multiple instances.
acceptanceCriteria: With two or more live update server instances running, a client connected to any instance receives every bid for the item it watches.
Adding an instance requires no code change.

requirements.title: Display-name identity
requirements.text: The system shall identify users by a unique display name of 2 to 20 characters, without a password, rejecting a name that is already taken, keeping one server-side user id per name and storing the issued user id in the browser, with any user able to act as both seller and bidder.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can enter a display name of 2 to 20 characters and use the system without a password.
A display name shorter than 2 or longer than 20 characters is rejected.
A display name already taken is rejected and the user must pick another.
The server assigns and stores one user id per display name and the browser keeps the user id it received, so the user is recognised on later visits.
The same user can list items and place bids on other users' items.
The system has no admin role.
Leading and trailing spaces are removed from a display name before the length and uniqueness checks, so 'Bob ' is the same name as 'Bob'.

requirements.title: Late bid extension
requirements.text: The system shall extend an auction's end time by 2 minutes when a valid bid is accepted within the last 2 minutes before the end time.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid bid placed less than or exactly 2 minutes before the end time moves the end time 2 minutes later.
A valid bid placed more than 2 minutes before the end time does not change the end time.
Watchers see the new end time without reloading.

requirements.title: Exchange rate caching and fallback
requirements.text: The system shall cache exchange rates for 1 hour and, when the exchange rate API is unavailable and no valid cached rate exists, show prices only in the item currency.
acceptanceCriteria: Within 1 hour of a successful fetch, no further request is made to Frankfurter for the same rates.
After the cache is older than 1 hour, the next conversion fetches fresh rates.
When Frankfurter cannot be reached and no valid cached rate exists, prices are shown only in the item currency and bidding still works.

requirements.title: Demo scale and live latency
requirements.text: The system shall support up to 200 concurrent watchers per item and a few bids per second, delivering each accepted bid to watchers within 1 second.
acceptanceCriteria: With 200 clients watching one item and a few bids per second, each accepted bid appears on every client within 1 second.
No accepted bid is lost under this load.

requirements.title: Reserve price
requirements.text: The system shall let a seller set an optional reserve price when listing an item, reject a reserve below the starting price, and show bidders only whether the reserve is met, never its amount.
acceptanceCriteria: A listing with a reserve price lower than the starting price is rejected with an error message and no item is created.
A listing with a reserve price equal to or higher than the starting price is accepted.
A listing without a reserve price is accepted and works as before.
When the auction closes with a highest bid below the reserve, the item is unsold and no winner is announced.
When the auction closes with a highest bid at or above the reserve, the highest bidder wins.
Item pages and lists of open items show whether the reserve is met (reserve met / not met) for items that have a reserve.
No item view, item list, API response or live event sent to bidders contains the reserve amount.
Live bid and close events carry the reserve-met state, so watchers see it update without reloading.

assumptions: Assumed: Is the reserve price entered and stored in the item currency, like the starting price and bids?
Assumed: Should the seller be able to see their own reserve amount after listing (e.g. on their item page)? The ticket says only that bidders never see it.
Assumed: For items without a reserve, should the item page show no reserve indicator at all (assumed), or something like 'no reserve'?
outOfScope: Notifications to winners or other users (the winner only sees the result on the item page)
Passwords, accounts with login and an admin role
Scale beyond demo level (more than 200 watchers per item or more than a few bids per second)
Display currencies other than CHF, EUR and USD
Changing or removing a reserve price after the item is listed
